categories.name: Electrical & Power
categories.description: LV/MV electrical installations, distribution boards, lighting controls, and authority testing.

services.name: Electrical Installation & Wiring
services.description: New circuits, rewiring and dedicated supplies for heavy equipment. Cable sizing and load calculations done properly.
specifications: XLPE/SWA/LSZH cable sizing per IEC 60364 and DEWA Wiring Regulations
Dedicated 3-phase circuits for chillers, pumps, machinery, and commercial kitchens
GI conduit, PVC trunking, perforated cable tray, and ladder installation
Load schedules, phase balancing calculations, and voltage drop verification (<4%)

services.name: Distribution Board Works
services.description: New boards, upgrades, breaker changes, load balancing across phases, correct labelling and schedules.
specifications: Main Distribution Boards (MDB), Sub-Main (SMDB), and Final Distribution Boards (DB)
Schneider / ABB / Siemens MCCBs, MCBs, ELCBs (30mA / 100mA / 300mA)
Engraved ferrule wire numbering, printed directory schedules, phase color-coding
Form 2 / Form 4 panel enclosures with IP55/IP65 weatherproof ratings

services.name: Lighting Installation
services.description: Indoor, outdoor and landscape lighting. LED upgrades, dimming and controls.
specifications: Architectural LED downlights, linear profiles, cove strips, magnetic track lights
IP67/IP68 submersible and landscape spike lighting with low-voltage step-down transformers
DALI-2, 0-10V, Phase dimming, Lutron and KNX lighting control modules
Lux level calculations (DIALux) compliant with Estidama and Al Sa'fat green building codes

services.name: Testing & Certification
services.description: Insulation resistance, earth continuity, loop impedance and RCD testing, with written results you can keep.
specifications: Calibrated Megger insulation resistance testing (500V / 1000V DC)
Earth electrode resistance (<5 Ohms for DEWA/ADDC, <1 Ohm for clean technical earth)
Earth fault loop impedance (Zs/Ze) and prospective short-circuit current (PSCC)
RCD trip time and sensitivity verification (1x, 5x test at 0° and 180°)
Formal signed & stamped Electrical Installation Certificate (EIC) test sheets

categories.name: Plumbing & Drainage
categories.description: Potable water supply, HDPE/uPVC drainage, sanitary fixtures, and non-destructive leak detection.

services.name: Water Supply Installation
services.description: Cold and hot water pipework, valves, filters and pressure systems using potable-approved materials.
specifications: PPR-C (PN16/PN20) fusion-welded, PEX-a barrier pipework, or Type K/L copper
WRAS / Dubai Municipality potable water certification for all fittings & valves
Variable frequency drive (VFD) pressure booster pumps, pressure reducing valves (PRV)
Central water filtration, UV disinfection systems, and thermal insulation with aluminum cladding

services.name: Drainage & Waste Systems
services.description: HDPE and uPVC waste, traps and floor drains, including F&B specification work for commercial kitchens.
specifications: Electrofusion & butt-welded HDPE or push-fit BS EN 1329 uPVC soil & waste pipes
Above-ground / below-ground grease interceptors (HACCP / Dubai Municipality F&B specs)
Stainless steel AISI 304/316 linear channel drains, cleanouts, deep-seal anti-odor floor traps
Acoustic insulated drainage pipework (Geberit Silent-PP / Polystop) for luxury residential

services.name: Taps, Mixers & Sanitaryware
services.description: Supply and installation of taps, mixers, showers, WCs, basins and water heaters. Replacing worn or leaking fittings and re-piping where needed.
specifications: Concealed cisterns (Geberit / Grohe), wall-hung WC pans, thermostatic concealed shower valves
Sensory touchless taps, floor-standing bathtub mixers, kitchen pull-out faucets
Electric storage water heaters (vertical/horizontal, enamel-lined) and central heat pumps
Flexible braided SS 304 connections, angle valves with anti-limescale ceramic cartridges

services.name: Leak Detection & Repair
services.description: Tracing hidden leaks, repairing the cause, and making the finishes good afterwards.
specifications: Acoustic listening rod, tracer gas injection (95% N2 / 5% H2), and FLIR thermal imaging
Endoscopic pipe inspection cameras with video recording and distance locator
Targeted tile / screed lifting, localized pipe splicing with electrofusion or press-fit couplings
Pressure re-testing at 1.5x operating pressure (min 10 bar for 2 hours) and tile/marble reinstatement

categories.name: Air Conditioning & Ventilation
categories.description: HVAC split, ducted, package, VRF systems, kitchen ecology units, and duct airflow balancing.

services.name: Air Conditioning
services.description: Supply, installation, servicing and repair of split, ducted and VRF systems.
specifications: Inverter Split units, Ducted Split, Package Units, and VRF/VRV multi-split systems (Daikin, O General, Mitsubishi, Carrier)
G90 galvanized iron ductwork (SMACNA standards), phenolic pre-insulated duct boards, acoustic lining
Refrigerant copper piping (R-410A / R-32 compliant) with Class 0 closed-cell elastomeric insulation
Smart digital thermostats (Nest, Ecobee, Honeywell, KNX BMS gateways)

services.name: Kitchen & Extract Ventilation
services.description: Extract hoods, ducting, fans and air balancing for kitchens and plant rooms.
specifications: AISI 304 stainless steel exhaust hoods with baffle filters and LED lighting (NFPA 96 & DM Code)
Black steel welded fire-rated extract ductwork with access doors at 3m intervals
Centrifugal / belt-driven inline extract fans and Ecology units (Electrostatic Precipitator + Carbon Filter)
Fresh air makeup fans, variable air volume (VAV) dampers, and digital anemometer airflow balancing

categories.name: Smart Home & Automation
categories.description: KNX, Zigbee, Crestron home automation, motorized shades, garage gates, and IoT sensor arrays.

services.name: Home Automation
services.description: Lighting, climate, curtains and access controlled from your phone or a wall panel. We can integrate with what you already have.
specifications: KNX protocol bus wiring, Crestron Home, Control4, Lutron Homeworks QSX, or Zigbee 3.0 wireless
Capacitive glass touch panels, smart scene keypads, and unified Apple HomeKit / Google / Home Assistant integration
Multi-zone audio matrix (Sonos, Russound, Bluesound) with architectural in-ceiling speakers
BMS gateway interfacing for HVAC, lighting, irrigation, and energy monitoring

services.name: Automatic Curtains & Blinds
services.description: Motorised tracks with remote, app or scheduled control. Quiet operation, tidy cabling, linked to your automation system.
specifications: Somfy Glydea Ultra / Tuya Wi-Fi & Zigbee quiet motorized curtain tracks (<30dB operation)
Dual-track setups (sheer + blackout) with custom curved tracks and ceiling recessed drywall pockets
Heavy-duty motorized roller shades with solar-screen and blackout fabrics
Scheduled astronomical sunrise/sunset triggers and integration with room occupancy sensors

services.name: Automatic Garage Doors
services.description: Motorised doors with safety sensors that stop on obstruction. Remote, keypad and phone access.
specifications: Overhead sectional, rolling shutter, and sliding gate automated drive systems (Sommer, Nice, BFT, CAME)
Dual infrared active photocell safety beams (auto-reverse on obstruction compliant with EN 12453)
Encrypted 433MHz / 868MHz rolling-code remotes, weatherproof wireless numeric keypads, GSM/App triggers
Integrated mechanical manual emergency release key during power outages

services.name: Door & Window Sensors
services.description: Magnetic contacts that tell you the moment a door or window opens. Alerts straight to your phone, and can trigger lights or alarms.
specifications: Concealed flush-mount or surface-mount magnetic reed switches (Grade 2 / Grade 3 tamper-protected)
Zigbee / Z-Wave / Hardwired dry-contact sensors reporting to central automation hub
Automated AC shut-off triggers when balcony sliding doors remain open >30 seconds
Push notification alerts, security arming logic, and siren strobe activation

services.name: House Control Sensors
services.description: Motion, presence, temperature, humidity, water leak and smoke sensors. Lights that come on as you walk in, and a warning before a small problem becomes a big one.
specifications: 24GHz mmWave radar human presence sensors (detects stationary breathing vs false pet triggers)
Dual-technology PIR + Microwave motion detectors for corridors and outdoor areas
Precision calibrated temperature & relative humidity sensors for climate PID loop control
Floor water leak probes with motorized automatic main water shut-off motorized ball valves
Photoelectric smoke and CO detectors with interlinked sounder alerts

categories.name: Security & Access
categories.description: SIRA compliant CCTV surveillance, biometric access control, video intercoms, and gate automation.

services.name: CCTV Cameras
services.description: Indoor and outdoor cameras with night vision and recording. Watch live on your phone from anywhere. We handle cabling, mounting, recorder and setup.
specifications: 4K / 8MP IP Network Cameras (Hikvision, Dahua, Axis, Hanwha) with ColorVu / DarkFighter night vision
SIRA (Security Industry Regulatory Agency) compliant camera positioning, storage (min 31-90 days RAID), and UPS power backup
AI-powered Human/Vehicle classification, perimeter virtual tripwire intrusion alerts, and license plate recognition (LPR)
Cat6 UTP/STP structured cabling, PoE+ gigabit network switches, and secure encrypted cloud mobile app viewing

services.name: Access Control & Intercom
services.description: Video intercom, keypad and card entry, and gate automation.
specifications: IP Video door stations with 1080p camera, RFID Mifare card reader, keypad, and indoor touchscreen monitors (Hikvision / Comelit / 2N)
Biometric facial recognition, optical fingerprint scanners, and Bluetooth mobile credential readers
600lbs / 1200lbs electromagnetic maglocks, fail-safe drop bolts, break-glass emergency egress units
Sliding & swing gate automation motors with flashing warning beacons and long-range RFID vehicle tags

categories.name: Specialist Equipment Installation
categories.description: Wellness chambers, saunas, cold plunge, commercial catering lines, and gym machinery.

services.name: Imported & Specialist Equipment
services.description: Assembly, hardwiring, testing and commissioning of equipment that arrives without an installation team. Wellness and therapy chambers, saunas, gym plant.
specifications: Uncrating, leveling, vibration isolation, and anchoring of heavy imported equipment
3-Phase 400V / Single-Phase 230V hardwired electrical connections with dedicated rotary isolators
Plumbing supply, chilled water loops, drainage hookups, and steam ventilation for wellness chambers & saunas
Manufacturer-guided commissioning, rotation check on motors, safety interlock testing, and handover testing sign-offs

services.name: Commercial Kitchen Equipment
services.description: Positioning and connection of water, drainage and power to catering equipment, to F&B specification.
specifications: Commercial combi-ovens (Rational, Unox), deep fryers, gas ranges, dishwashers, and blast chillers
High-temperature CPVC / copper water supply with dedicated water softeners and backflow preventers
Direct indirect air-gap drainage discharge into dedicated grease traps per municipality hygiene code
Gas pipework connection with solenoid safety shut-off valves linked to fire alarm gas leak detectors
HACCP compliance documentation and municipal food safety inspection clearance

categories.name: Ceilings, Finishes & Fit-Out

services.name: Gypsum Ceilings & Partitions
services.description: Suspended ceilings, bulkheads, coves and partition walls. We cut in for lights, AC grilles and speakers, then tape, skim and paint to a finished surface.
specifications: Knauf / Gyproc regular, moisture-resistant (MR green board for wet areas), and fire-rated (Type X pink board)
Suspended galvanized steel MF ceiling grid, concealed shadow gaps, curtain pelmets, and indirect LED lighting coves
Precision CNC/manual cut-outs for downlights, linear diffusers, AC return air grilles, and access panels
3-coat joint compound taping, full skim coat plastering, primer, and premium emulsion paint finish (Jotun/Caparol)

services.name: Epoxy Resin Flooring
services.description: Seamless resin floors for garages, kitchens, plant rooms and terraces. Hard wearing, chemical and slip resistant, easy to clean.
specifications: Substrate diamond grinding, shot-blasting, crack injection, and moisture barrier epoxy primer
Self-leveling epoxy flooring (2mm to 4mm thickness) or heavy-duty polyurethane resin screeds (Fosroc / BASF / Jotun)
Anti-slip quartz broadcast aggregate for commercial kitchens, wet areas, and parking ramps (R10 / R11 slip rating)
UV-resistant aliphatic polyurethane topcoat for outdoor terraces and plant rooms, chemical & oil resistance

services.name: Builders Work & Making Good
services.description: Core drilling, penetrations, fire-stopping joinery adjustment and reinstatement of finishes.
specifications: Diamond core drilling (50mm to 300mm diameter) through reinforced concrete slabs and masonry walls without structural damage
Civil Defense certified intumescent fire-stopping pillows, acrylic sealants, and fire-wrap collars for pipe/cable penetrations
Blockwork opening creation, steel lintel installation, plaster repair, and screed patching
Tile, marble, parquet, and wallpaper reinstatement matching existing architectural finishes flawlessly

categories.name: Documentation & Support
categories.description: AutoCAD/BIM shop drawings, Material Approval Requests, Method Statements, AMCs, and certified manpower.

specifications: AutoCAD 2D and Revit BIM Level 2 coordinated MEP composite overlay drawings (clash detection resolved)
Comprehensive Material Approval Requests (MAR) with manufacturer compliance sheets, ISO certs, and sample boards
Detailed Method Statement (MOS) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITP) per BS / ASHRAE / DEWA engineering standards
As-Built Drawings and Operation & Maintenance (O&M) manuals formatted for facility handover

services.name: Maintenance Contracts
services.description: Scheduled preventive maintenance for villas and commercial premises, with call-out cover.

Filter cleaning, coil washing, refrigerant pressure checks, electrical thermography, and drain line flushing
24/7 Emergency call-out response with guaranteed 2-hour SLA for critical power or water outages in UAE
Detailed digital asset log, maintenance history reports, and preventive replacement recommendations

Complete PPE provision (helmets, safety shoes, hi-vis vests, harness) compliant with Dubai Municipality HSE regulations
